subject.title: Bug: Stale Connection Pool / TCP Keep-Alive Mismatch causes silent Exec failures

question: After a current-version transport trace identifies the failing client, should OpenClaw change a shared Gateway connection policy or make a narrow client/transport-specific reliability fix?
rationale: The proposed fixes have materially different compatibility and availability effects, and the current report does not identify the transport owner that would make either choice safe.

options.title: Collect transport evidence first
options.body: Request a sanitized diagnostics export, exact Exec host/endpoint, proxy details, timestamps, and an idle-then-retry trace before selecting a connection policy.

options.title: Adopt a shared connection policy
options.body: Deliberately change Gateway keep-alive or response-close behavior only after proving the affected clients and upgrade impact.

recommendation.title: Collect transport evidence first
recommendation.body: Request a sanitized diagnostics export, exact Exec host/endpoint, proxy details, timestamps, and an idle-then-retry trace before selecting a connection policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior work is the closest available evidence of involvement in Exec policy and diagnostic guidance, though ownership of this transport path remains uncertain.
